data.name: Gav
data.gender_notes: Gav is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Gav means 'God is my strength' or 'God is the source of my power'. This name was borne by several figures in the Old Testament, including the Israelite warrior Gideon and the priest Eleazar. The name Gav carries the meaning “God is my strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gav usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the strength of God be with you.
data.etymology: Gav belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gav total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_greek.name: Γάβ
in_greek.long_meaning: Γάβ (Gav) προέρχεται από την ελληνική και σημαίνει 'το θρέμμα' . Η ονομασία Γάβ έχει τις ρίζες του στην αρχαία ελληνική γλώσσα. Στη Βίβλο, το όνομα Γάβ (Gav) εμφανίζεται ως προσωνύμιο για τον Θεό. Η ονομασία Γάβ έχει σχέση με την ιδιότητα του Θεού ως θρέφτη και φύλακας των ανθρώπων. Στη χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Γάβ συμβολίζει την προστασία και την φροντίδα του Θεού για τα παιδιά του.

in_english.name: Gav
in_english.long_meaning: Gav is a name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'to lift or to exalt'. In the Bible, the name Gav appears as a title for God, signifying His power and authority. In Christian tradition, the name Gav symbolizes God's protection and care for His children. Gav is also a shortened form of names beginning with the letters Gav, such as Gabriel, which means 'God is my strength'. The name Gav is associated with qualities such as strength, courage, and faith. In modern times, the name Gav has become popular in some Christian cultures, particularly in the United States.
